# Storio & GrowthBook Commercials
Date: 2026-11-10 | Duration: 25.290000915527344m

## Summary
The discussion covered executive sponsorship, commercial approval, seat planning, and the transition from LaunchDarkly to GrowthBook. Emanuele briefed Michelle, CPO, who plans to discuss experimentation and GrowthBook at Thursday’s GET executive session. Marketing and commercial alignment remains important, particularly around discounting and promotion testing. Emanuele is advocating for PEAK A/B testing, with an A/A test planned to demonstrate low operational risk. James proposed seat-based pricing at 1,500 per seat per year, with greater flexibility possible for larger commitments such as 80 seats. Emily said the January 15 decision target may be difficult and requested stronger commercial terms and quarterly or biannual payments. Initial usage may require 45–50 seats, expanding to 75–80, while platform teams could raise demand to approximately 105. LaunchDarkly’s January renewal creates timing pressure, with six-month and one-year extensions under review. Next steps include updated commercial terms, seat confirmation, scaled training plans, and technical discussions.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Seat-based pricing, A/B testing, LaunchDarkly migration, PEAK process, Experimentation budget
